dedupe_keys.name: forecasting energy consumption analysis and simulation tool industry forecast industry

description: Forecasting Energy Consumption Analysis and Simulation Tool - Industry (FORECAST Industry) is a model listed in Open Energy Platform model and framework factsheets, a public register of energy-system model and framework factsheets under the section "Models", published or maintained by Fraunhofer Institute for Systems and Innovation Research. FORECAST Industry primarily examines which technologies and energy sources would be used in the industrial sector under given framework conditions (including, for example, macroeconomic development, energy source prices, CO2 prices, demand for/production volume of basic materials, available technologies) from the perspective of a predominantly rational actor (taking into account observed restrictions on rationality). Coverage: Germany. Methodical focus: energy demand modeling, bottom-up simulation. Time resolution: annual. Software: MS Visual Studio 2017, Visual Basic. The listed link gives the source code or documentation; nothing was downloaded or run. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the factsheet. Caveats: this record was written from the Open Energy Platform factsheet only, so the code, documentation and any publication it links were not opened, their current availability was not checked, and the factsheet may lag the project. It can support energy-system planning and scenario studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-oep-factsheet-catalogue.
